draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 74th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 14th of 36 at WR. He went 94th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 917 receiving yards in 2025, 11th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
